notes.title: Patch Note 1.0.5_2
notes.content:
This is the most ambitious and heartfelt game we've ever created, and throughout development, we faced many challenges. As an indie team working on a game packed with new and risky features, there were many things we simply couldn't anticipate. We also lacked the experience to accurately predict a solid release date.



Even though there were still potential bugs, we decided not to delay the release any further after already missing our promised launch date twice. At that point, many fans were urging us to release the game quickly, even though we personally wanted a bit more time to test the closed beta more thoroughly.



Still, we didn’t want to let the community down, so we made the tough decision to release and collect feedback to fix and improve the game over time. Right now, the game is in a fairly stable state. The early stages might feel a bit slow, but we hope you'll be patient. Once you get the hang of it, we believe you'll really enjoy it and feel the passion and care we've poured into every part of the game.



We’re committed to continuing to improve the experience based on your feedback.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/18906d5b46af930fb2ef98eefe2ebddec2809c13.jpg"]

Fixed UI stretching issue for Liu Yalin.

Fixed bug where unlocked texting images weren't showing in the phone collection.

Updated missing texting images for Qin Yilin.

Fixed bug where Liu Yalin appeared on the minimap, but her room didn’t show up in the area.

Previously, if you completed a level but hadn’t finished the task, the next task wouldn’t allow claiming the reward right away (you had to wait until the next session). Now, if you meet the conditions, you can claim the next reward immediately after completing the task.

Corrected the mission count display for side girls.

Improvements:

Days of the week (Monday–Sunday) have been localized for all supported languages.

Recipes can no longer be sold to avoid bugs.

Item title and description now display properly in the inventory. Item quantities are now shown in shop descriptions.

Lock passwords are now easier to read.

Updated the merge UI to handle large quantities (more than 2 items).

Updated UI for stamina and fortitude display in the menu before entering “Socialize.”

Adjusted text color for the Immunity stat.

notes.title: 🥹Release Delayed — A Heartfelt Apology & a Small Gift for our beloved community
notes.content:
New Release Date: 4:00 AM, 18 July (Pacific Time)
—just a little longer, but we promise it will be worth the wait.



———
🤗 To Our Wonderful Community,
We’re truly sorry for the delay in releasing Love n Life: Happy Student. Over the past weeks, we’ve received so many messages from you saying how long you’ve been waiting for the release, and we’re deeply grateful for that anticipation and support. Your patience, encouragement, and trust mean the world to us—they inspire us every day to make our games better and more polished.

We are deeply grateful for the incredible support from our beta testing group, who are loyal members of our community. They have worked diligently throughout the beta phase, sharing creative ideas and providing valuable feedback.

The great news is that our beta testers have given high praise to the refined gameplay mechanics and enhanced graphics in Love n Life: Happy Student, highlighting them as major improvements over our previous titles. However, there are still some bugs that need to be addressed to make your first experience as smooth and enjoyable as possible.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/d85d555fe027cff1653d57654c4fffd94fff455c.png"]
❓Why the Delay?
Compared to our previous games, Love n Life: Happy Student has a much larger scope—more story branches, more CGs, more events, and more… well, everything.

That means:

• A huge script size with complex multilingual syncing.

• A few remaining bugs that might frustrate early players.

• The user experience still needs improvement to ensure it doesn’t impact gameplay.

• Helpful feedback from beta testers gave us a list of usability improvements we’d love to implement before release.

🥹 Although our team has been working 12+ hours a day to test and polish everything, the workload has been heavier than expected, with some changes and challenges beyond our control.

✨ On the bright side, our art team has used this extra time to create even more beautiful illustrations for you to enjoy in the final game!


🎁 A Small Gift While You Wait
To express our gratitude and hopefully brighten your wait, we’re sharing an exclusive, high-resolution illustration of one of the heroines. Feel free to download it, set it as your wallpaper, or simply keep it as a token of our appreciation.

➡️ Happy Teacher's Wallpapers



Thank you for your understanding and unwavering support. We can’t wait to share the finished game with you! 



With love 💕,

Reborn Entertainment Team.

notes.content:
Hey Talented Students!



We’re thrilled to share that Love n Life: Happy Student is now in its final stretch! Our whole team is working tirelessly on the last crucial steps, QA, bug fixes, and polishing every detail, to make sure you get the best possible experience.



We faced some tough times and delays during Lucky Teacher's release, but your support has kept us going. Thank you for sticking with us. We promise the wait this time will be worth it.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/132d05cbe56e4ff2a175cb6a6038591a141dfa2b.jpg"]



Additionally, releasing during the 2025 Steam Summer Sale would mean competing with major titles and heavy discounts, which could hurt our visibility. Love n Life: Happy Student, a game we’ve poured our hearts into, deserves the best chance to shine.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/f4086e462869f8982afccd48647db16ddab6db08.jpg"]




💡 Games Made with Heart
At Reborn, our mission is simple: to deeply understand our community and keep innovating to bring you fresh, meaningful experiences. Our games have always stood out for their unique gameplay and storytelling, even if our graphics still have room to grow.



We believe anime dating games can offer more: more heart, more innovation, more freedom, and more memorable experiences. That’s why we focus on crafting fun gameplay, deep stories, and unique characters that let you slow down, explore, and truly connect.



We’re committed to creating a truly immersive experience. We’re tackling these challenges head-on, not just in our current games, but in every game we make moving forward. Our goal is to deliver something genuinely different: games where your choices matter, where stories and characters feel alive, and where you can truly unwind and enjoy yourself.



We’re incredibly proud to share that after our recent wishlist campaign, Love n Life: Happy Student has reached 51,941 wishlists, a huge leap from Lucky Teacher’s 40,000 at launch! This amazing milestone is a testament to your support and shows us we’re on the right path. The whole team is buzzing with excitement as we approach our launch.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/9ab609d5c90557593c6a342ff8195941a75a5324.jpg"]


🌱 Growing Together, Dreaming Bigger
We’re still a young team, and every project is a leap of faith. A single misstep on a major game could stretch our resources thin. That’s why we’ve learned to be patient with our key future projects.



Every sale helps us grow: it means more resources, more experience, and the chance to bring even more talented people onto our team. We know the demo still has a few rough edges, and that some game design elements were intentionally left unbalanced so you could explore and unlock more content freely. Rest assured, the full release will be carefully balanced and polished to deliver the best experience possible.



Thank you for being part of this incredible journey. Your support means everything, and together, we’re building something truly special.

Item Management System

 Item Placement: This is the core mechanic of Combat. You need to place items into designated slots to prepare for Socializing.
 Star-Link System: Some special items have gray stars around them. When you place items of the same type next to each other, you activate the star’s buff, boosting the item’s power and stats.
 Item Merge: This feature allows you to combine two items into a brand-new, higher-rarity item with superior stats.
 Item Upgrade: This feature lets you enhance an item while keeping its original form and stats. With each level-up, the item's attributes increase accordingly.

 Knowledge: Specializes in debuffs and psychological effects, causing damage over time. Balanced Impact power with high stamina.
 Confidence: Built for defense, strong Steadfastness and high Confidence make you an unshakable force.

 Recovery Build: Stay in the conversation with high-confidence recovery. Use items that restore Confidence and Stamina continuously to outlast your opponents.

notes.title: Dev Log December 2024 - Love n Life: Happy Student
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/4e10f997609a3de689023d7849de6decc5db06bd.gif
Every choice you make shapes their lives. Are you ready to meet the characters who will change yours?

When we design a character, especially one who will be your companion for a long journey, we pour our hearts and souls into every detail. From countless sketches to endless hours of refinement, we work closely with our VIP community to uncover the perfect faces that bring these characters to life. When it comes to their physiques and color palettes, our aim is clear: the moment you see them, their posture and the spark in their eyes should tell you everything about their style and personality.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/e3073717cd26942f48fd4c8167e8e6dcbda770aa.jpg


When it comes to environments, we combine advanced tools with architectural expertise and thoughtful design to craft spaces that feel both logical and deeply immersive. Our goal is to draw you into a world where every detail makes sense and enhances your experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/f2e3af58bb163189f95e0092ab53ba89626fb5ef.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/c126ba8c2b3b86bcd4977886c2ee2869c9ab6361.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/1bac5150bd9c1c0188bd00d238365fd468d2f6cb.png

Liu Yating
After the rain comes the sunshine, and Yating embodies the perfect example of life's unstoppable energy. Carefree, vibrant, and overflowing with positivity, her optimism helps her rise above any negativity life throws her way.

Her design reflects this youthful dynamism, with bright colors that highlight her gentle femininity and irresistible charm. Imagine having a beautiful, lively classmate who also happens to share your dorm. What could be more heartwarming and relatable?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/49255f5768fa4c2c24a9f35d19a82900a031b2d0.jpg


Chen Meiling
"A man’s true potential lies in what he can achieve tomorrow." 
As a literature professor, Meiling holds the key to mastering the balance of life. She’s a caring and compassionate guide, always looking out for those she values. As both your dorm supervisor and a nurturing mentor, Meiling ensures every lesson is heartfelt. Whether it’s her guidance or the unexpected moments you’ll share in the dorm.

Her design blends a classic elegance with a youthful vibrancy. Does that sound like a contradiction? Discover more in Love n Life: Happy Student.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/31a2930d83c97f7a3efbdf11f8a07e0c10173256.jpg


Qin Yilin
When it comes to challenges, Yilin is the embodiment of discipline and determination. In academics, she has to be at the top. In every activity, she commands the game. The armband she wears isn’t just for show. It’s a symbol of the drive forged by her childhood and past experiences, which will undoubtedly surprise you. Stay tuned to learn more about Yilin’s story.

Yilin’s design exudes power and pride, balanced with elegance, discipline, and strength. You’ll be the one to uncover the events that shaped her into the formidable person she is today.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/4e7f33b1fafd9a1e7609f8ee35cb5b713556f826.jpg


Luna-3X
Your ultimate virtual assistant and so much more. She’s not just here to help you adapt and excel in your studies. She’s your go-to confidante, a cheerful companion, and even a quirky maid-slash-digital-girlfriend! Funny, kind, and completely drama-free (yes, no jealousy here), Luna-3X will even teach you how to win the ladies’ hearts. Her carefree nature puts her a step above Yating when it comes to lighthearted fun. Luna-3X guarantees laugh-out-loud moments and takes your relaxation to the next level. Just make sure you don’t accidentally turn her off!

Her cyberpunk-inspired design blends futuristic aesthetics with sleek modern vibes, delivering an experience that feels truly ahead of its time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/fa4962cf48ffd1212b449cb637c75d777c8e4986.jpg


And even more ladies are waiting for you:
Because you deserve even more, we’re excited to share a glimpse of some of the side characters you’ll meet in the game. Here are their sketches. Curious about their stories? Dive into Love n Life: Happy Student to find out more later!

Not only have many people purchased both the DLC and the base game, but we've also received valuable feedback, bug reports, and a lot of interest in our team. Please continue to support us, and if you encounter bugs, we would greatly appreciate it if you could send us the save files, logs, or screenshots with the version number. notes.title: Love n Life: Happy Student - Craft Timeless Memories, Ignite the Flames of Romance
notes.content:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/b8e1419a2bd4b7c762f8bdcab68ddff973033537.gif

At Reborn Entertainment, creativity drives everything we do as we’re committed to delivering fresh experiences. For us, fun isn’t just a goal—it’s the rule. Incorporating the Inventory Management system in Love n Life: Happy Student will bring the excitement of dating to life in a way you’ve never seen before.

Love n Life: Happy Student not only builds upon the best aspects of its predecessor but also introduces groundbreaking features in its gameplay. Our new ladies’ stories and designs are even more meticulously crafted to evoke wonderful feelings, allowing you to immerse yourself in remarkable romantic experiences fully. Thanks to your love and support for our past and current games, we've brought in additional artists, including a lead art designer, who has elevated the visual quality to new heights.

Join us and explore the new exciting features and stunning visuals of our charming ladies!

About the game:
You're a third-year college student living in the suburbs. After taking a competitive exam, you’re lucky enough to transfer to the prestigious Lingyun University, an elite school reserved for the best of the best. Upon arrival, you’re placed in an old dorm, where your exciting new student life begins.

You'll interact with various girls, each with her own personality and preferences. The innovative inventory management system adds a fresh twist to the dating sim genre, where the items you collect and manage can influence your relationships and interactions. Balance your time, resources, and decisions to create meaningful connections and explore multiple story paths.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/d47c6ced028061498fa6e312decf0beb720bd6c3.jpg

Features:

 Experience dating through the unique Inventory Management system!
 Give presentations, read books, play basketball, and engage in charity work in Daily Activities.
 Try your hand at fishing and cooking in mini-games.
 Complete Girls’ Missions and Side Missions.
 Beautiful girls come to life with Live2D animations.
 Choose your words carefully—your choices affect affection levels with Dynamic Conversations.
 Stay connected with social apps, texting, collections, and more using your phone.
 And other fund and interesting features.


Liu Yating
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/65c845c6333f8d3ceb17e07c8676f6f1eabe240e.jpg
You're in the same class as a beautiful, carefree girl who loves to explore new things. She’s destined to become your best friend.

Qin Yilin

"Only knowledge and discipline create elite students. Without them, you're dust." The Student Council President is cool, elegant, and well-organized. She’s determined to push every student to reach their highest potential—no matter what it takes!

Chen Meiling

The literature teacher at your school and the dorm manager where you live. With her sweet, kind, and playful personality, she’s the teacher every student loves having in class!
